name: VSA Veterinary Alerts
description: VSA veterinary practice alert management — phone-call analysis, transcription status, and clinical notifications (V4 external module).
author: InHouse Print
notes: V4 external rewrite (live). Supabase URL + service-role key are NO LONGER in the manifest — they are stored per-org in ai_infrastructure.organisation_platform_credentials (the 'supabase_vsa' row from migration 036) and resolved server-side by AI_infrastructure/routes/vsa_supabase_proxy_routes.py via resolve_credentials('supabase_vsa', user_id=g.rls_user_id). All browser fetches go through that vault-backed proxy (/api/vsa-supabase-proxy/dashboard, /api/vsa-supabase-proxy/calls). Admin-only seeding via POST /api/vsa-supabase-proxy/seed-vault writes the vault row. The 21-stage call analysis pipeline still lives in the external Supabase project and is not ported yet. See UI/modules_external/woocommerce/woocommerce-v4.js for the structural template this module mirrors.
